documents.title: Air-Gapped Agent Reference Architecture
documents.content:
# Air-Gapped Agent Architecture
All local agent runtimes operate under default network denial (`offline-deny`). Outbound internet sockets, DNS lookups, and HTTP proxies are disabled by policy. Local model serving uses quantized GGUF or AWQ weights verified by SHA-256 manifests prior to load.

## Durable State and Recovery
Every workflow persists checkpoints and side-effect ledgers in SQLite with WAL journaling enabled. Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is 0 committed steps and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is under 60 seconds from local backup snapshots.

documents.title: Offline Security, Secrets, and Approval Standard
documents.content:
# Security and Human Oversight
Secrets are stored exclusively inside the encrypted local vault using PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 key derivation and authenticated MAC verification. Secrets must never be injected into model prompts or persisted in plaintext logs.

## Approval Gates
Destructive file mutations, database deletes, credential rotations, export bundles, and break-glass elevations require explicit human approval bound to the SHA-256 hash of the proposed action payload. High-impact actions require dual-control approval from two distinct authorized reviewers.

documents.title: 3-2-1 Continuity and Disaster Recovery Standard
documents.content:
# 3-2-1 Backup Standard
Production deployments maintain 3 copies of durable state across 2 distinct local storage media types with 1 offline air-gapped vault copy. Backup verification drills restore memory, vector, workflow, and tamper-evident audit databases into a clean instance every 7 days.
